Container.Name: Nespresso Stats
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted dashboard for your Nespresso Vertuo capsule inventory: what you have, how many of each, brew history, coffee stats and optional auto-decrement when the machine brews a coffee.
No login is built in - it is made for a trusted home network. Expose it to the internet only behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
Container.Description:
Self-hosted dashboard for your Nespresso Vertuo capsule inventory: what you have, how many of each, brew history, coffee stats and optional auto-decrement when the machine brews a coffee.
No login is built in - it is made for a trusted home network. Expose it to the internet only behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
Point any brew detector (Home Assistant, BLE, smart plug) at POST /api/brew-detected to log brews automatically. Photo identify uses an optional OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint; set VISION_MODEL to empty to turn it off and identify by colour alone.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Nespresso Stats web dashboard.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database (nespresso.db). Delete it to re-seed the starter capsule catalogue.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. Default 99 = nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Default 100 = users.

Config.Name: VISION_BASE_URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for photo identify. 127.0.0.1 is the container itself, so point this at your Ollama host, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1.

Config.Name: VISION_MODEL
Config.Description: Vision model name. Leave empty to turn vision off and identify capsules by colour alone.

Config.Name: VISION_API_KEY
Config.Description: API key for the vision endpoint. Ignored by a local Ollama; set your Ollama Cloud key when using https://ollama.com/v1.
